Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.3: Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to describe where, when and how something happens? 2. Which words do we use to describe different actions?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical thinking and problem solving: Learners develop the skill of reflection as they logical reason and think of different ways to

describe manner, time, and place

● Learning to Learn: Learners develop the skill of organising own learning as they identify and use different types of adverbs

Values:
● Responsibility: is developed as learners record videos and describe the events with peers responsibly.

Link to other Subjects

The learner relates the concepts of adverbs of manner, place and time to their learning in Kiswahili and Kenya Sign Language.
